caption:
🚄 One day of trains in France — Thursday 15 October 2026.

9,117 trains across 2,421 stations: every TGV INOUI, OUIGO, Intercités and TER. Watch the star: the lines all converge on Paris, a layout set in 1842 when the network was planned from the capital outward. Peaks: 1,082 trains on the move at 07:20, 1,127 at 18:44.

📊 Data: SNCF Voyageurs GTFS, transport.data.gouv.fr (Licence Ouverte). Each train follows the real track (SNCF Réseau & OpenStreetMap network); positions interpolated between stops.
🌍 Relief: AWS Terrain Tiles · Natural Earth.
